status_assessment: Be careful! You need to start improving with respect to your Depression, Movement and Obesity. In the long term, you may still be at the risk of Anti-Stress.
recommendations: Restrict the intake of sugars-sweetened soft drinks. Increasing levels of physical activity: engaging in one hour of moderate physical activity per day (ex. walking). Share your feelings with a trusted friend in person or talk to a psychologist. Get a journal and write your thoughts out. You must engage in at least 30 minutes of moderate physical activity such as brisk walking or aerobic exercise every day. Play a sport you enjoy or go for a walk or run. Don't spend too much time in one place, take breaks often to walk around or stretch.
